subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Truthfully speaking, the victories of peace and harmony have a more _________ impact on human civilization than the so-called victories of war.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'** i.e. **'Lasting'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lasting:** This word means enduring, continuing, or having a long-term impact.(स्थायी)
 
• It accurately **fits the context** of the sentence. 
 
• It is** emphasizing **that the victories of peace and harmony have a more enduring or long-lasting effect on human civilization compared to the victories of war, which are often temporary or fleeting.

Therefore, the **correct sentence **is: *'Truthfully speaking, the victories of peace and harmony have a more** Lasting** impact on human civilization than the so-called victories of war'.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Superior: **This word means higher in quality, rank, or importance.(उत्कृष्ट)

 
 
• While it can be related to the impact on human civilization, it does not directly convey the idea of longevity or duration, which is the focus of the sentence.
 
 
 
• **Transient:** This word means lasting only for a short time, temporary, or fleeting.(अस्थायी)
 
 
• It is the opposite of what the sentence is conveying, as it suggests a short-term impact
 
 
 
• **Greater:** This word means larger in amount, size, or intensity.(अधिक)
 
 
• While it conveys a sense of superiority or significance, it does not explicitly focus on the duration or lasting impact mentioned in the sentence.
